story_text: As a user, I want to update the description of a task so that I can add more context.

positive.title: Update description with valid text
steps: 1. Send a PUT request to /tasks/{task_id} with a valid description in the request body.
2. Verify that the response status code is 200 OK.
3. Verify that the response body contains the updated description.
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · description field updated in response

positive.title: Update description and verify persistence
steps: 1. Send a PUT request to /tasks/{task_id} with a valid description in the request body.
2. Verify that the response status code is 200 OK.
3. Send a GET request to /tasks/{task_id} and verify that the response body contains the updated description.
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · description field updated in response · subsequent GET request returns updated description

negative.title: Update description of a non-existent task
steps: 1. Send a PUT request to /tasks/{non_existent_task_id} with a valid description in the request body.
2. Verify that the response status code is 404 Not Found.

negative.title: Update description without authentication
steps: 1. Send a PUT request to /tasks/{task_id} with a valid description in the request body.
2. Verify that the response status code is 401 Unauthorized.

negative.title: Update description of another user's task
steps: 1. Send a PUT request to /tasks/{task_id} with a valid description in the request body.
2. Verify that the response status code is 403 Forbidden.

edge.title: Update description to empty string (clear description)
steps: 1. Send a PUT request to /tasks/{task_id} with an empty string as the description.
2. Verify that the response status code is 200 OK.
3. Verify that the response body contains the updated description.

edge.title: Update description with very long text (e.g., 10,000 characters)
steps: 1. Send a PUT request to /tasks/{task_id} with a very long description in the request body.
2. Verify that the response status code is 200 OK.
3. Verify that the response body contains the updated description.
edge.expected_result: 200 OK · description field updated in response · subsequent GET request returns full long description

edge.title: Update description to null (remove description)
steps: 1. Send a PUT request to /tasks/{task_id} with a null value for the description.
2. Verify that the response status code is 200 OK.
3. Verify that the response body contains the updated description.

edge.title: Update description with HTML/script tags
steps: 1. Send a PUT request to /tasks/{task_id} with HTML/script tags in the description.
2. Verify that the response status code is 200 OK.
3. Verify that the response body contains the updated description.
edge.expected_result: 200 OK · description field updated in response · subsequent GET request returns escaped HTML/script tags
